kfn.description: Exact k farthest-neighbor search (k=10) over road-network object sets. Benefit: how few objects a method has to retrieve individually and how few exact network distances it computes, relative to evaluating every object. Constraints: every answer exact, index size and index construction work within budget.
kfn.notes: colt / colt_default / alt_filter / bruteforce rows: this workspace's pipeline in the paper's own setting (scripts/evaluate.sh -> eval/evaluate.py: original NW travel times, the eight real POI categories as published plus uniform d=0.001, public query seed), job 82d200b3-495. colt uses the paper's Table 8 kFN parameters (b=4, m=4, Slice landmarks, lambda=256, 16 ALT root landmarks); colt_default uses b=8, m=2, Random. Candidates count individually retrieved objects plus opened non-empty index nodes (the paper counts objects only; on the held-out test colt's objects-only value is 1.43 vs 1.37 with nodes). Scale: the NW subset (1.09M vertices) of the paper's 24M-vertex US network, Dijkstra instead of PHL, so the paper's numbers are kept under _paper_* keys: read off the paper's log-scale Figure 11c/11d (continental US, uniform objects at d=0.0001, ~2.4k objects, the closest object-set size to this benchmark), approximate.

log10_candidate_reduction.description: Mean over queries of log10((|P|+1)/(candidates+1)), floored at 0. Candidates = objects revealed individually + non-empty index nodes accessed; 0 = every object retrieved individually.

log10_call_reduction.description: Mean over queries of log10((|Q||P|+1)/(exact distance computations+1)); 0 = brute force.

exact_answer_rate.description: Fraction of exact answers (ties at the k-th distance accepted). Any wrong answer, crash or protocol violation scores the method with the worst value of every metric.

index_entries_per_vertex.description: Landmark distance-list entries per road-network vertex (index size). Capped at 40 for kFN.

sdl_work_per_vertex.description: Vertices settled while building the landmark distance lists, per vertex (index construction cost). Capped at 3000 for kfn.

aknn.description: Exact aggregate k nearest-neighbor search (k=10, |Q|=8 query vertices drawn from a 15% subnetwork, max and sum aggregates). Same benefit and constraint metrics as kfn.
aknn.notes: Same provenance as kfn (job 82d200b3-495, paper setting). colt uses the paper's Table 8 AkNN parameters (b=8, m=2, Random, lambda=256), which coincide with colt_default. _paper_colt_phl is read off the paper's Figure 8b (max aggregate, A=15%, d=0.001, ~24k objects on the 24M-vertex network) and is approximate; the paper reports AkNN candidates only at that density.

log10_call_reduction.description: Mean over queries of log10((|Q||P|+1)/(exact distance computations+1)); 0 = brute force.

exact_answer_rate.description: Fraction of exact answers (ties at the k-th aggregate distance accepted). Any failure scores the method with the worst value of every metric.

index_entries_per_vertex.description: Landmark distance-list entries per vertex. Capped at 24 for AkNN.

sdl_work_per_vertex.description: Vertices settled while building the landmark distance lists, per vertex (index construction cost). Capped at 600 for aknn.

range.description: Exact range search (radius 2.5% of the network diameter). Same benefit and constraint metrics as kfn.
range.notes: Same provenance as kfn (job 82d200b3-495, paper setting). colt uses the paper's Table 8 range parameters (b=8, m=2, Border Minmax, lambda=256). _paper_colt_phl is read off the paper's Figure 13d (r=2.5% D, d=0.0001, ~2.4k objects) and is approximate.
